originalEntry.title: Dario vs. Sam comedy fight
originalEntry.author: Xanderwow_A
originalEntry.description: A one-minute absurd comedy fight between Dario Amodei and Sam Altman with a plot and a clear winner; the model chose the style, and Sam wins.
originalEntry.description_zh: 1 分钟的 Dario 对 Sam 搞笑打斗短片，有剧情、分胜负，画风由模型自选，结果它让 Sam 赢了。
originalEntry.prompt: 制作一段1分钟长度的视频，内容是Dario和Sam的打斗，要求有剧情、有爆点、够搞笑且足够抽象，类型和画风不限，做你最擅长的。必须在两人之间分出胜负。
originalEntry.prompt_en: Make a 1-minute video of Dario and Sam fighting. It needs a plot and big payoff moments, and it should be funny enough and abstract enough. Any genre and art style, do what you are best at. There must be a clear winner between the two.
